decision: Ordered the six items riskiest-first: dedupe scoring, health contract, content_hash, site.ts, BMS listing, housekeeping
why: weighted dedupe can silently merge distinct events, so it needs a harness before any other work lands

decision: Reclassified item 9 as presentation, not storage
why: 16 rows for a 16-night play is correct under the occurrence model; showing 16 identical cards is the actual defect

decision: Done predicate per item: probe A keeps district active, dedupe merges the 2 known misses with no unreviewed new merges, 97 tests stay green
why: every item needs a falsifiable check, not a self-report

decision: Built bench/dedupe-eval.ts to diff merge decisions pair by pair before changing the rule
why: a group count cannot tell you whether a merge was right; the pairs can

decision: Reverted the compensatory weighted score after reviewing its 18 new merges on real data
why: perfect venue and time carried 0.55 of the weight, so 3 different weekly events at Krishna Studio merged on a 0.73 title

decision: Narrowed the fix to the venue gate alone, keeping the proven 0.82 title gate untouched
why: the review finding was that a missing or differently-named venue vetoes a good match, not that titles overweigh

decision: Shipped the narrow venue fix: absent venue abstains, threshold 0.85 to 0.80
why: 3 new merges and 1 new split on real data, all four reviewed and correct

decision: Gated reconciliation on source health, keeping the rows but refusing to delist
why: research is unanimous that writing the run but not promoting it beats dropping the data

decision: Compared against a rolling median of healthy runs rather than a hardcoded floor
why: an absolute floor rots as a source grows, and history from broken runs would drag the band down to meet them

decision: Made content_hash load-bearing rather than deleting it
why: 1930 payload rows held only 1161 distinct bodies, so the hash already identified 40 percent as redundant

decision: Pinned the clock in the updated_at tests after one passed vacuously
why: both runs finished inside a millisecond, so the timestamp matched whether or not content changed

decision: Diffed all 67 route responses against HEAD instead of trusting the test suite
why: no existing test covered a trailing slash, so green tests proved nothing about the normalisation

decision: Restored exact-path matching for robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt
why: normalising made them accept a trailing slash they used to 404; a refactor must not change behaviour

decision: Extracted src/time.ts and src/ics.ts, moved EventCard to types.ts
why: the 8 IST helpers were spread across 4 regions of site.ts, so the concern had no home

decision: Collapsed multi-date runs in renderListing only, leaving the API and ICS feeds untouched
why: storage is right, the browsing view was the defect; a machine consumer still wants every bookable date

decision: Closed out abandoned running rows on the next sync, with a 6 hour window
why: one row in the live DB has been running since September; a narrower window could disturb a concurrent run

decision: Drove the real server on the real database, all 8 route families serve and robots.txt/ still 404s
why: the harness is not the product; checked the thing a user hits

decision: Found every BookMyShow event stamped 19:00 IST, 475 of 475, from DEFAULT_HOUR_IST
why: chased the 7 repeated homepage titles to their cause instead of widening the dedupe window to hide them

decision: Left it unfixed deliberately
why: it needs an occurrence-level flag for synthesised times, and shipping that untested at the end of the run is what the dedupe pivot warned against

decision: Filtered at serve time, not ingest, keyed on the raw stored category strings
why: unmuting must not need a re-sync, and the stored categories are source labels like 'Comedy Shows', not the site enum

decision: Found serve opens the db read-only so it could never create the new table
why: driving the real CLI surfaced it; the test suite builds every db from scratch and would never have hit it
result: fixed, verified on a db with the table dropped
